question: what is the percentage change in the amount of guarantees from parent company from 2007 to 2008?
reasoning: We need percentage change in parent company guarantees from 2007 to 2008. From Note 16: "The amount of such parent company guarantees was $255.7 and $327.1 as of December 31, 2008 and 2007, respectively." So 2008=255.7, 2007=327.1. Percentage change = (255.7-327.1)/327.1 = -71.4/327.1 = -0.2183... = -21.83%. So answer -21.8% or -21.83%. Need exact. Compute: 327.1-255.7=71.4; 71.4/327.1=0.21828... So -21.83%. Provide evidence.
